verdict.rationale: mParticle's IDSync is documented as its own identity resolution framework. It unifies known and anonymous identities across apps and platforms into a single view, and the docs claim it gives users control over identity management. The evidence does not show the actual configurable rules (identity strategies, matching or merge logic), and anonymous-to-known stitching and cross-device merging are described only at a high level. missing for 10: documented, configurable identity-resolution rules and matching strategies, explicit detail on anonymous-to-known profile merging across devices, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, anonymous and known activity stitches into one customer profile across devices, with documented and configurable identity-resolution rules

citations.quote: IDSync is mParticle's identity resolution framework, enabling you to create a unified view of your customers
IDSync gives visibility into, and control over, the management of known and anonymous user identities across apps and platforms.
